content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for PJTSAU Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by Professor Jayashankar Telangana Agricultural University (PJTSAU) for filling temporary positions.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post advertised in PJTSAU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The advertised post is Teaching Associate across different departments such as Biochemistry and Crop Physiology, and Soil Science & Agril. Chemistry.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available under this notification?
faq.answer: A total of 2 vacancies have been announced for the Teaching Associate positions under this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q4. What is the mode of application for PJTSAU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The mode of application is Walk-in. Candidates do not need to submit any prior online applications and can directly attend the interview.

faq.question: Q5. When is the walk-in interview scheduled for?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled to be held on 01 October 2026 at the designated venue as per the official notification.

faq.question: Q6. What are the educational qualifications required for the Teaching Associate posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an M.Sc.(Ag.) in Crop Physiology or M.Sc.(Ag.) in Soil Science & Agril. Chemistry depending on the specific department they are applying for.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary offered for PJTSAU Teaching Associate positions?
faq.answer: The salary ranges from Rs. 49,000 to Rs. 54,000 per month, specifically offering Rs. 54,000/- per month for Ph.D. holders and Rs. 49,000/- per month for M.Sc. (Ag.) candidates.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee required to attend the interview?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for attending the walk-in interview.

faq.question: Q9. What documents should candidates carry to the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must bring a detailed bio-data, all original educational and supporting certificates, two passport-size photographs, and two sets of attested photocopies of all relevant documents.

faq.question: Q10. Where can candidates check more details or download the notification PDF?
faq.answer: Candidates can check the official website of Professor Jayashankar Telangana Agricultural University or use the important links section provided in this article for direct access.
